work.title: Resilience and Economic Growth in the Arid Lands (REGAL-IR)
work.summary: A $45.5m five-year project to raise living standards and food security for drought-affected pastoralists in northern Kenya.
work.imageAlt: Illustration: a pastoralist woman checks the flow at a solar-powered water point in northern Kenya as herders bring camels and goats to drink.

work.title: Early Warning and Response Design Support (EWARDS)
work.role: Chief of Party, Tetra Tech ARD
work.summary: A $4.5m conflict early warning and response project for West Africa.
work.imageAlt: Illustration: a community early-warning monitor in a reflective vest stands on a wall in a West African market town and addresses residents through a megaphone, with a radio mast behind.

work.title: Civil Society Media Leadership evaluation
work.summary: Mid-term evaluation of an $11.9m program building civil society and community radio across seven counties.
work.imageAlt: Illustration: blue watercolor silhouettes of Liberian women and men in profile, led by a radio host at a microphone, with faint radio waves spreading outward.

work.title: Protecting Communities from Violence evaluation
work.summary: Final evaluation of 40 community protection committees linked by HF radio to UN field bases.
work.imageAlt: Illustration: a high-frequency radio and an open logbook on a veranda above the terraced hills of South Kivu and Lake Kivu, where a community protection committee member keeps watch.
